title: Form
summary: A form of kit fields: submit validates them all and fires formsubmit with the values; errors by name show on the named fields.

examples.label: Fields and a submit button
examples.subject: component:form
examples.markup: <ui-form><ui-input name="email" label="Email" type="email" required></ui-input><ui-field label="Plan"><ui-radio-group name="plan" value="pro" orientation="horizontal"><ui-radio value="free">Free</ui-radio><ui-radio value="pro">Pro</ui-radio></ui-radio-group></ui-field><ui-button type="submit" variant="primary">Sign up</ui-button></ui-form>

examples.label: Server errors by name
examples.subject: component:form
examples.markup: <ui-form errors='{"email":"Already registered","plan":"Not available in your region"}'><ui-input name="email" label="Email" value="ada@example.com"></ui-input><ui-field label="Plan"><ui-radio-group name="plan" value="pro" orientation="horizontal"><ui-radio value="free">Free</ui-radio><ui-radio value="pro">Pro</ui-radio></ui-radio-group></ui-field><ui-button type="submit">Save</ui-button></ui-form>

examples.label: Errors on blur
examples.subject: component:form
examples.markup: <ui-form validation-mode="onBlur"><ui-input name="name" label="Name" required></ui-input><ui-input name="code" label="Code" minlength="4"></ui-input><ui-button type="submit">Check</ui-button><ui-button type="reset">Reset</ui-button></ui-form>
